correctness.rationale: For positive ordered r, parity lattice gauge gives λ1=min(2/r1,1/r2), λj=1/rj j>=2 by dimension rank obstruction, and the interior parity-character sum yields I=(∏(2ceil(rj)-1)+(-1)^Σ(ceil(rj)-1))/2. For integer m, algebra gives defect=((A-1)P+eta)/2; its sign/equality tests are exhaustive. Isotropic intervals follow from piecewise-constant I and increasing (2r-1)^n. Independent brute lattice counts and exact defect checked 117 cases n=2..4, 1<=m_i<=3. No extrapolation from enumeration is used.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not alone prove the claimed all-parameter result; proof-specific bounds established in analytic argument.
